species.real: The Roaches wallabies came through several hard winters by eating heather and bracken, but the colony has now probably died out, though sightings still crop up.
species.name: Roachroo

dex.text: Lolls about the Roaches as if it owns the place, which is fair, because in a sense it does. Nobody invited it, and nobody has yet managed to make it leave.
dex.fact: Wallabies were let out of a private zoo near the Roaches around 1940, and a wild colony lived on there for decades.
